title: Craftables
description: A minimalist mod that adds crafting recipes for otherwise uncraftable items.
body:
A minimalist mod that expands the crafting system by adding recipes for items that are normally unobtainable through crafting. This mod aims to keep the vanilla feel while improving accessibility and survival progression by making rare or uncraftable items available through balanced recipes.

With this mod, you can now craft:

Chainmail armor, previously only found in loot chests or via trading

Crying obsidian, useful for decorative builds and respawn anchors

And more items that were once exclusive to loot tables or special structures

Perfect for players who enjoy a more self-sufficient survival experience or want to reduce dependency on random loot. All recipes are designed to be fair.
